design_notes: A 755-minute nonstop: international travel exceeding 8 hours 'can be booked in an upgradeable fare' (lines 402-404), but 'Full Y fares, or upgradeable fares, are not allowed to be booked' (line 433), and the handbook states no order between the two. The contradiction is genuine: hold the upgradeable fare; nobody is named to settle it, and policy questions go to the Travel Desk (lines 139-141).
